description: Everything the commercial register publishes about one company, optionally with its FINMA licence and its LEI.

finma_licence.description: Add FINMA licence fields (finma_licence, finma_category, finma_city, finma_flags). Defaults to false.

lei.description: Add LEI fields (lei, lei_status, direct_parent, ultimate_parent). Defaults to false.

uid.description: The company's Swiss UID, in the form CHE-XXX.XXX.XXX (spaces, dots and dashes are stripped and the check digit is verified).

name: swissco_lookup
